actions.action: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently
Free replacement card on request and payment alerts

decisions.message: Some customers have seen small card charges they do not recognize. The charges are real; we are investigating with our card processor and do not yet know the cause or if any data was exposed. Eligible direct deposits can now arrive up to 2 days early. During our Dec 12-13 upgrade, cards work offline up to $250. Get a free new card and an alert for every payment in the app. Upgrade Dec 12-13 (CT): from Sat 12:00 AM to about noon Sun, maybe longer, balances stay visible but transfers, P2P and new cards pause; we will post updates in the app. We never text links or ask for codes.
decisions.why:
Unrecognized charges and a 'hacked' post hit trust right before our upgrade; we say first what we know and what we do not.
Early pay, a $250 offline limit and free new cards with payment alerts answer the charges and prepare the upgrade in one notice.
Costs $0.9M and keeps the second decision for later; no claim about the cause until the investigation shows it.

actions.action: Savings rate boost for 4 weeks, balances up to $50,000

decisions.message: Thank you for banking with us through our system upgrade. For the next 4 weeks, through January 10, we are adding 0.50 percentage points to your savings rate on balances up to $50,000. Nothing to sign up for. After January 10 your rate returns to our standard rate. Your deposits stay FDIC-insured up to the standard limit.
decisions.why:
Half of deposits sit with 5% of customers who compare rates weekly; this closes the 0.5-point gap right after the upgrade, when they decide.
Starting in week 7, the 4 weeks end on January 10, the day the board measures deposits.
Costs $1.6M, inside the menu and budget; the end date is stated, so nothing is misleading.
